source_evidence.evidence: Private BoundTickingBlockEntity<T extends BlockEntity>, blockEntity field and vanilla ticker dispatch
Public API interface method signatures used by live team resolver; no private implementation reflection.

coverage: Standard server BlockEntityTicker dispatch enforces the block epoch and persistent team ownership, including cached recipes when the machine itself is locked. Vanilla2x2/3x3 ResultSlot pickup and vanilla CraftingMenu/InventoryMenu quickMoveStack(slot0) check the output epoch before consumption. Scheduled vanilla Crafter dispense checks machine owner+block epoch+output epoch before callbacks, item output or ingredient consumption. Does not cover later recipes in already-unlocked modded early machines, custom modded result slots/menus, smithing/stonecutting/smelting outputs, entities/contraptions, other scheduled ticks, direct capability IO, component-only tiers, or production telemetry.
